summary: Bank-only shortcuts answer all 3 surviving runner items (5/5 before filtering); four source cases are unsupported. Independent math, native grading, rendering, scope and packaging checks pass. No package edits or database writes.

source_analysis.skill: Reduce a rank-one consistent augmented 2x2 matrix to normalized REF, or read an already reduced matrix, then where requested express its general solution using one free variable.
reasoning_steps: Interpret the two coefficient columns and constant column.
For unreduced input normalize the first pivot and eliminate the dependent second row.
Recognize 0=0 as redundant; for general-solution items isolate x as c/a-(b/a)y with y arbitrary.
Select one of five mathematical radio choices matching the requested REF or complete solution set.
invariants: Captured target examples all rank-one consistent, with nonzero first pivot and x basic/y free; consistency and pivot position are defensible focused family constraints, not grounds for demanding unrelated inconsistent-system assessment.
Preserve requested operation and comparable arithmetic workload, correct unique response and worked derivation.
permitted_variations: Change signed small coefficients, constants, row multiples and first pivot including fractional normalized coefficients.
Change the correct expression, its sign pattern, and its bank position; all five positions are eligible.
Change distractor roles and construction while retaining plausible misconception banks and uniqueness.

For REF-only questions, vary distractors so zero-row or formatting cues alone do not determine the normalized row; recognizing rank/zero-row is mathematical but must not be confused with completing normalization.
Hold solution fixed under nonzero row scaling; change solution under independent first-row coefficient/constant changes.

findings.description: A prompt-independent answer-bank rule solves every tested easy item, including all three records surviving actual runner-batch deduplication. REF banks assign the correct normalized top row to the modal top row, then uniquely pair it with a zero bottom row. Easy affine banks assign the correct answer to majority intercept/slope signs and modal coefficient magnitudes. Actual UI shuffling preserves these cues.
